body: 2026-10-16 (built in 252b629). Setup-tokens live one year. A `stored` login past added+lifetime is refused; token_cmd / token_env logins only warn ('approximately'). Why: agx knows when a cmd/env login was registered, not when the token behind it was minted; a token rotated in the secret store would otherwise be blocked while it still works. `agx doctor` warns 30 days before. Code: provider.LoginLifetimer.
title: Logins D13: refuse only stored logins past expiry
